name: Click Buffer
description: Buffers early clicks for a few frames so a slightly-early tap still jumps on landing.

buffer-frames.name: Buffer Window (frames @ 60 FPS)
buffer-frames.description: How early you can click and still have it count.

cube-like-only.name: Cube / Robot / Spider Only
cube-like-only.description: Skip ship, UFO, ball, wave and swing, where extending a hold would change your movement.

disable-on-rated.name: Disable on Rated Levels
disable-on-rated.description: Turns the buffer off on levels with stars.
